blurb:
Put your feet up, because the crystal ball says you’re resting tomorrow with a meager 39.7% chance of lacing up. 

Sure, your usual weekday motivation is trying to save face (+0.448) and your mileage base is putting in work (+0.123), but the universe is conspiring against your couch-to-5k dreams. For starters, you're looking at a toastier-than-normal low that's a whopping 9.81 °F above the seasonal average, alongside a high hitting 54.68 °F. Add in some drizzle with rain in the forecast showing up 29.17% of the day, and suddenly staying inside looks awfully appealing. 

If that wasn't enough, your 28-day fitness base is lagging at 18.81 effort points/day, and you haven't touched a hard effort in 25.0 days. Face it: you've earned a day off, mostly because the weather and your own sluggish momentum demanded it.
